meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 装上后，它能直接处理 PDF 文件：提取文字和表格、填写表单、识别扫描件文字、合并拆分文档，并在每步校验数据。出错时给出明确错误提示。
howto.when: 当你需要处理复杂的 PDF 任务、一次处理很多份 PDF，或要求每个步骤都经过校验时，这个技能就会起作用。

say.text: 提取这个 PDF 里的所有表格，保存为 CSV。
say.note: 会运行表格提取脚本，生成 CSV 文件。

say.text: 分析这份 PDF 表单的字段结构，输出 JSON。
say.note: 会生成包含字段、类型和位置的 JSON。

say.text: 把这三个 PDF 合并成一个文件。
say.note: 会合并成单个 PDF 并输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, it can process PDFs directly: extract text and tables, fill forms, recognize text in scans, merge/split documents, and validate data at each step. Clear error messages on failure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to handle complex PDF workflows, process large volumes of PDFs, or require strict validation and error handling.

say_en.text: Extract all tables from this PDF and save as CSV.
say_en.note: Runs table extraction and generates a CSV file.

say_en.text: Analyze the form fields in this PDF and output JSON.
say_en.note: Generates JSON with field names, types, and positions.

say_en.text: Merge these three PDFs into one file.
say_en.note: Combines them into a single PDF.
